players.product: Power Systems division: backup engines and gas engines for prime power at data centres; next-generation engine to replace the Series 4000, targeting the data centre market with increased power density (launch 2028)

quarterly_data.signal: DoD award: firm-fixed-price modification to contract N00024-25-C-2405 with Rolls-Royce Corp. (Indianapolis, Indiana) for production of spares for the Ship to Shore Connector, Landing Craft, Air Cushion (LCAC 100) craft program, including six spare MT7 turboshaft engines with ancillary parts and installation kits; funded under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act; expected completion December 2029; contracting activity Naval Sea Systems Command, Washington, D.C.
